ai_analysis.summary: The supplied excerpt is a high-level, promotional roadmap rather than a complete technical explanation. It claims a five-step plan for data engineering interview rounds and lists SQL, Python, Spark, data warehousing/data modeling, and cloud services, followed by learning and mock-interview links. The excerpt does not explain the listed subjects or provide worked examples; it ends with an ellipsis and has no extracted media text, so the supplied post may be incomplete.
